gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.PdfViewer
gettingStarted.overview: PDF.js powered PDF viewer component for Tempo.Blazor with thumbnails, search, text layer, rotation, zoom, and continuous scroll.

items.description: Pending, not-yet-saved annotation created by an annotator tool: kind, anchor, and completed ink strokes.
Active tool of the PDF annotator: Browse, Highlight, Comment, Stamp, or Draw.

The context handed to TmPdfViewer.PageOverlayContent for every rendered page overlay slot: the one-based page, whether the viewer currently shows it, the page box in CSS pixels at the current zoom (0 until the JS geometry report arrives) and the document rotation in degrees.

How the viewer presents its search UI on desktop and tablet layouts, driven by TmPdfViewer.SearchPresentation. Floating (the default since 2.9.1) anchors a role=search card top-right over the page body — outside the scroll area and never covering the toolbar; Escape closes it and returns focus to the toolbar's search toggle. Inline restores the pre-2.9.1 full-width bar under the toolbar. A mobile layout always keeps the in-flow (sheet-style) bar regardless of this value.
Describes a text selection captured from the PDF text layer: the selected text, the one-based page it belongs to, and the normalized highlight rectangles covering it.

items.description: View mode for the PDF viewer.

How the viewer decides the zoom scale. Custom means the scale is controlled by the user (zoom buttons, presets, binding); FitWidth and FitPage let JavaScript compute the scale from the container size and keep recomputing it on resize. The Auto value arrives with a later phase of the PDF redesign and is deliberately not part of the enum yet.
Extension methods for registering Tempo.Blazor PDF viewer services.

members.name: AddTempoBlazorPdfViewer
members.description: Registers the services required by the PDF viewer component group. Also calls AddTempoBlazor(), so the core services do not need to be registered separately.

items.description: Standalone PDF annotation workbench built on top of TmPdfViewer. Offers highlight, comment, stamp, and freehand drawing tools in a single hierarchical toolbar (the annotator's groups are merged into the viewer toolbar through its ToolbarStart/ToolbarEnd slots, with an optional header row for the title/subtitle and the export group), a comment thread panel with resolve/reopen and an All | Unresolved filter, a runtime color picker for NEW annotations (ColorPalette/ColorNames/AllowColorPicker, two-way AnnotationColor), per-author or per-role annotation colors, pass-through access to the viewer's thumbnails, search, rotation, zoom mode and open link, export of annotations into the PDF (as real PDF annotations or flattened into the page content), and a print variant with a comment summary. Persistence is pluggable through IPdfAnnotationProvider.

parameters.name: AllowColorPicker
parameters.description: Whether the runtime color picker is offered. Default true; when false the toolbar keeps the pre-phase-12 static chip + label indicator and no palette tile renders on mobile.

parameters.name: AllowExport
parameters.description: Whether export and print actions are offered. Default is true.

parameters.name: AllowRotation
parameters.description: Whether the viewer's rotation button is offered. Default is false; passed through to the embedded viewer.

parameters.name: AnnotationColor
parameters.description: Explicit color (CSS value) stored with annotations created in this annotator. When null (default) colors resolve per author/role at display time. Supports two-way binding: the runtime color picker (phase 12) raises AnnotationColorChanged, and a host-supplied value seeds the picker's selection.

parameters.name: AnnotationColorChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the runtime color picker changes the color for NEW annotations (a pick raises the color, the reset raises null — the per-author/role fallback).

parameters.name: AnnotationProvider
parameters.description: Provider used to load and persist annotation threads. When omitted, an in-memory provider keeps annotations for the lifetime of the component.

parameters.name: AnnotationsChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the loaded annotation set changes.

parameters.name: AuthorColors
parameters.description: Annotation colors per author, keyed by user id.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: ColorNames
parameters.description: Accessible names for the ColorPalette colors, keyed by the color string (matched case-insensitively, like the core TmColorPalette). Defaults to the localized TmPdfAnnotator_ColorName_* names of the default palette.

parameters.name: ColorPalette
parameters.description: Colors offered by the runtime color picker. Defaults to PdfAnnotationColorHelper.DefaultPalette (the helper owns the palette data).

parameters.name: CurrentUser
parameters.description: Author applied to annotations created in this annotator.

parameters.name: DocumentId
parameters.description: Stable document identifier used by the annotation provider. Falls back to Url.

parameters.name: ExportFileName
parameters.description: File name used for the exported PDF. Defaults to the source name with an "-annotated" suffix.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Extra host actions rendered at the end of the header row, after the export group. Used only when ShowHeader is true.

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Content rendered at the start of the header row. Used only when ShowHeader is true.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: Height of the annotator (CSS value). Default is "600px". The root owns the height contract; the embedded viewer fills it and shrinks inside it on a mobile layout.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: How the annotator decides its responsive layout. Auto measures the annotator's own container through the embedded TmEditorShell; a forced value renders that layout without measuring, so a test — or a host — can pin a mode. Default Auto. The mobile layout is the G2 presentation: viewing plus light edits only.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Active tool. Supports two-way binding. Default is Browse.

parameters.name: ModeChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the active tool changes.

parameters.name: RoleColors
parameters.description: Annotation colors per role, keyed by role.

parameters.name: SearchPresentation
parameters.description: How the embedded viewer presents its search UI on desktop and tablet layouts. Default Floating (a card anchored over the page body); passed through to the embedded viewer. A mobile layout always keeps the in-flow bar.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: Whether a header row (title, subtitle, export group and host actions) is rendered above the merged toolbar. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowOpenLink
parameters.description: Whether the "Open in new tab" link is rendered (in the merged toolbar, or in the header row when ShowHeader is true). Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowPanel
parameters.description: Whether the thread panel is rendered. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowPanelChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the panel's close button requests to hide the panel (two-way ShowPanel binding).

parameters.name: ShowResolved
parameters.description: Whether resolved annotation threads are shown by default. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowResolvedChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the resolved filter toggles.

parameters.name: ShowSearch
parameters.description: Whether the viewer's search is offered. Default is false; passed through to the embedded viewer.

parameters.name: ShowThumbnails
parameters.description: Whether the viewer's thumbnails sidebar is offered. Default is false; passed through to the embedded viewer.

parameters.name: ShowViewerToolbar
parameters.description: Kept for backward compatibility. When true (default) the annotator has no toolbar of its own: its tool groups merge into the embedded viewer's single toolbar through the viewer's ToolbarStart/ToolbarEnd slots, and the export group lives in the header row when ShowHeader is true. When false the viewer's chrome (navigation, zoom, rotation) is hidden and the annotator renders a compact tools row of its own instead.

parameters.name: StampOptions
parameters.description: Stamp texts offered in stamp mode. Defaults to localized Approved/Rejected/Draft/Confidential.

parameters.name: Subtitle
parameters.description: Document subtitle rendered in the header row. Used only when ShowHeader is true; when omitted the viewer shows a neutral page count.

parameters.name: ThumbnailsCollapsed
parameters.description: Whether the thumbnails sidebar is collapsed. Supports two-way binding; the annotator tracks the state so an unbound host keeps the user's choice. Default is false.

parameters.name: ThumbnailsCollapsedChanged

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Document title rendered in the header row. Used only when ShowHeader is true.

parameters.name: ToolbarLabels
parameters.description: Whether the toolbar's icon buttons show their text labels. Default Icons (the icon-only tools of the earlier phases); Auto and IconsWithText show the labels — on a tablet layout under the icons (the ribbon style of the tablet reference). The value is passed through to the embedded viewer's toolbar as well.

parameters.name: Users

parameters.name: ZoomMode
parameters.description: How the viewer's zoom scale is decided. Supports two-way binding; passed through to the embedded viewer. Default is Custom.

parameters.description: Callback when the zoom mode changes in the viewer.

items.description: Shared thread filter of the PDF annotation panels (TmPdfViewer and TmPdfAnnotator, phase 12): the 'All (N) | Unresolved (M)' segmented control rendered in both panels' headers. It replaced the phase-4 'Show resolved' checkbox — the All segment maps onto ShowResolved=true and Unresolved onto false, so the public panel contract is unchanged. The segments are native radios sharing one group name (the TmRadioGroup Appearance=Segmented model): the browser owns the arrow keys and there is no keyboard emulation. Counts recompute from Threads on every render, so resolve/reopen mutations update them live.

items.description: A reusable PDF viewer component powered by PDF.js v5. Supports page navigation with an editable page input, zoom presets with fit modes (Auto = fit-width on mobile), rotation, text layer, collapsible thumbnails, search, an optional document header, and continuous scroll. The toolbar is a core TmToolbar with priority-based overflow and optional visible labels; tablet and mobile layouts present the thumbnails and the comments panel as sheets with a mobile action bar.

parameters.name: AllowDownload
parameters.description: Whether to allow downloading the PDF. Default is true.

parameters.name: AllowRotation
parameters.description: Whether to allow rotation. Default is false.

parameters.name: AnnotationProvider
parameters.description: Provider used to load and persist annotation threads when EnableAnnotations is true. When omitted, an in-memory provider keeps annotations for the current session.

parameters.name: Annotations
parameters.description: Optional seed threads used when no AnnotationProvider is supplied.

parameters.name: AnnotationsChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the loaded annotation set changes.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: CurrentUser
parameters.description: Author applied to annotations created by the current viewer.

parameters.name: DocumentId
parameters.description: Stable document identifier used by the annotation provider. Falls back to Url.

parameters.name: EnableAnnotations
parameters.description: Whether the annotation layer and comments panel are enabled. Default is false. The markers render per page in both view modes — in Continuous every page inside the ±50% viewport band gets an overlay slot (the same band the lazy renderer uses), and text selection creates threads on the selection's page.

parameters.name: EnableTextSelectionEvents
parameters.description: Enables text selection events (OnTextSelected) without turning on the built-in annotation layer and panel. Default is false.

parameters.name: FileSize
parameters.description: The document's byte size shown in the header. When set, this host-supplied value wins over the length the viewer obtains from PDF.js getDownloadInfo; when omitted and the size is unknown, the subtitle keeps its pages-only form.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Content rendered at the end of the document header, after the Open/Download links. Used only when ShowHeader is true (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Content rendered at the start of the document header. Used only when ShowHeader is true (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: Height of the viewer (CSS value). Default is "600px".

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: How the viewer decides its responsive layout. Auto measures the viewer's own container; a forced value renders that layout without measuring, so a test - or a host - can pin a mode.

parameters.name: OnDocumentLoaded
parameters.description: Callback invoked with the total page count once the document is loaded.

parameters.name: OnTextSelected
parameters.description: Callback invoked when text is selected in the viewer text layer.

parameters.name: OverlayContent
parameters.description: Optional content rendered in an overlay that is kept aligned with the current page canvas (used by TmPdfAnnotator to draw its own annotation layer). Single-page only: the overlay is aligned to THE canvas, so in Continuous view mode it is not rendered — use PageOverlayContent for per-page overlays.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Current page number (1-based). Supports two-way binding.

parameters.name: PageChanged
parameters.description: Callback when the page changes.

parameters.name: PageOverlayContent
parameters.description: Templated per-page overlay (FZE-13). In Continuous it renders for every mounted page — the pages inside the ±50% viewport band the JS renderer reports — as an absolutely positioned slot over the page box, next to the annotation markers. In SinglePage it renders once, aligned to the current page canvas. The slot itself is not interactive (pointer-events: none); hosts opt their content back in. The context carries PageNumber, IsCurrentPage, Width, Height and Rotation.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Current zoom scale. Supports two-way binding.

parameters.name: ScaleChanged
parameters.description: Callback when the scale changes.

parameters.name: SearchPresentation
parameters.description: How the search UI is presented on desktop and tablet layouts. Default Floating (since 2.9.1): a card anchored top-right over the page body, outside the scroll area; Escape closes it and returns focus to the toolbar's search toggle. Set Inline to restore the pre-2.9.1 in-flow bar under the toolbar. A mobile layout always keeps the in-flow bar.

parameters.name: SelectionCtaContent
parameters.description: Content rendered in the in-flow sticky selection CTA row, outside the scroll area (since 2.9.1). Hosts (the annotator) supply their own sticky selection actions here; the viewer's own comment CTA is independent and may render in the same row.

parameters.name: ShowFileSize
parameters.description: Whether the document header's default subtitle appends the formatted file size ("Pages: N \u00b7 1.4 MB"). Only applies when ShowHeader is true and no explicit Subtitle is given. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: Whether to show a document header above the toolbar. Default is false, which keeps the toolbar-only layout. When true, the Open and Download links move from the toolbar into the header (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ShowMobileActionBar
parameters.description: Whether the viewer renders its own mobile action bar (Pages | Search | Comments). Hosts that fold these entries into their own action bar (the annotator) pass false and drive the sheets through OpenThumbnailsSheetAsync / OpenSearchAsync.

parameters.name: ShowOpenLink
parameters.description: Whether to show an "Open in new tab" link. Default is true (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ShowResolvedAnnotations
parameters.description: Whether resolved annotation threads are shown by default. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowSearch
parameters.description: Whether to show a search input. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowTextLayer
parameters.description: Whether to render a selectable text layer over the canvas. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowThumbnails
parameters.description: Whether to show a thumbnails sidebar. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowToolbar
parameters.description: Whether to show the toolbar. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowViewModeToggle
parameters.description: Whether to show a view mode toggle (single/continuous). Default is false.

parameters.name: Subtitle
parameters.description: Document subtitle rendered in the header. Used only when ShowHeader is true. When omitted, a neutral page count ("Pages: N") is rendered once the document is loaded (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ThumbnailsCollapsed
parameters.description: Whether the thumbnails sidebar is collapsed. Supports two-way binding; the collapse button in the sidebar header and the toolbar "Pages" toggle both drive it. Default is false (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ThumbnailsCollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Callback when the thumbnails collapse state changes (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Document title rendered in the header. Used only when ShowHeader is true (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ToolbarEnd
parameters.description: Content rendered at the very end of the toolbar (after the built-in groups), letting hosts such as TmPdfAnnotator compose their own tool groups into the toolbar (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ToolbarLabels
parameters.description: Whether the toolbar's icon buttons show their text labels. Default Icons (the icon-only toolbar of the earlier redesign phases); Auto shows the labels except on a toolbar narrower than the mobile breakpoint, and IconsWithText always shows them.

parameters.name: ToolbarStart
parameters.description: Content rendered at the very start of the toolbar (before the navigation group), letting hosts such as TmPdfAnnotator compose their own tool groups into the toolbar (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: URL of the PDF document to display.

parameters.name: ViewMode
parameters.description: Current view mode. Default is SinglePage. In Continuous the document renders as a lazily painted vertical column: pages entering the viewport are painted one at a time, canvases scrolled far out of view are released, scrolling updates the current page (and the two-way Page binding), and navigation, thumbnails and search scroll the wrap. Annotations render on every mounted page (PDF-VIEWER-CONTINUOUS-ANNOTATIONS); selecting a thread scrolls to its anchor instead of switching the mode.

parameters.name: ViewModeChanged
parameters.description: Callback when the view mode changes.

parameters.name: ZoomMode
parameters.description: How the zoom scale is decided. Default Auto: fit-width on a mobile layout, the bound scale everywhere else. FitWidth and FitPage let JavaScript compute the scale from the container size (and keep recomputing it on resize); any zoom button or preset switches the mode back to Custom. Set Custom to restore the pre-Auto behavior at every width. Supports two-way binding.

parameters.name: ZoomModeChanged
parameters.description: Callback when the zoom mode changes (since 2.9.1).

items.description: Redaction layer for PDF documents (over TmPdfViewer) and image previews: drag rectangles over sensitive content, categorize them by PII type, preview before/after, persist through IRedactionProvider, and export DESTRUCTIVELY - the JS pipeline rasterizes the pages, burns the black rectangles in, and rebuilds a brand-new file from the pixels only, so the original text/image content is not extractable from the export (this is not a visual overlay).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: DefaultCategory
parameters.description: Category assigned to newly drawn areas. Default is Other.

parameters.name: DocumentId
parameters.description: Document identifier used with the provider.

parameters.name: ExportFileName
parameters.description: Export file name. Defaults to "redacted.pdf" / "redacted.png" by mode.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: Viewer height for the PDF mode.

parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: URL of the image to redact, when no PDF is set.

parameters.name: OnAreasChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked whenever the set of areas changes, with a snapshot.

parameters.name: OnExported
parameters.description: Callback invoked after a successful export, with the file name.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: Optional persistence of the redaction definitions.

parameters.name: ShowPanel
parameters.description: Whether the area panel is shown. Default is true.

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: URL of the PDF document to redact. Mutually exclusive with ImageUrl (PDF wins).
